items.title: The internal hom of a bounded above complex of finite free summands with a bounded below complex is the termwise internal hom complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma extends the termwise description of the derived internal hom from strictly perfect complexes to bounded above complexes whose terms are direct summands of finite free modules (statement lines 11958-11977). The proof (proof lines 11979-12022) resolves the second complex by a bounded below complex of injectives, identifies both sides as total complexes of the same double complex, compares them through the first quadrant spectral sequence, and reduces the remaining statement to the finite free case. H2: one spectral sequence comparison with a finite-free reduction, written out.
